title: TypeScript 7.1 Beta: Restores the Compiler API and Makes Vue and Svelte First-Class
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/11/typescript-7-1-beta/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1793901816316.jpg"/><p>TypeScript 7.1 Beta, announced October 20, 2026, restores the compiler API removed in 7.0, now split into separate entry points. It adds content mappers, letting tools like Vue check non-standard files. One Vue project's type checks fell from 14.19 to 3.10 seconds. An editor issue remains open, and teams may need TypeScript 6 alongside 7.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>
